test_GraphConv_undirected: test GraphConv with undirected edges on vertex features and validate output against expected tensor values
test_GraphConv_directed: test GraphConv with directed edges to verify neighbor aggregation only propagates in edge direction
test_gather_scatter_backward: test gather_scatter backward pass on CUDA and CPU to verify gradient computation matches across devices
test_gather_scatter_cuda_python: test gather_scatter CUDA and Python implementations produce identical results for both directed and undirected graphs
run_graph_conv_forward_backward: run a GraphConv forward and backward pass on Meshes with configurable dimensions, vertex count, and backend
